ccpd_sample.zip -- 31 verbatim files (original paths and Big5 bytes) of the Chinese Chess
Practical Dataset, used by tests/test_xiangqi_pipeline.py (and, as the move lists
Fairy-Stockfish replayed, ffish_ccpd_sample.json.gz by tests/test_xiangqi_reference.py).

Yu-Han Tseng and Bo-Nian Chen (2026). Chinese Chess Practical Dataset (CCPD).
Retrieved from https://github.com/Yvonne761/Chinese-Chess-Practical-Dataset
(commit 368a47a947773dd8692c026e286dd19b6277b993, the archive `gmdata xiangqi fetch`
downloads). Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0),
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ -- the files are unmodified; only a
selection is included, repacked (entries sorted, fixed timestamps).

Entries (below Chinese-Chess-Practical-Dataset-368a47a947773dd8692c026e286dd19b6277b993/):
